note: Checked-in baseline for the FULL ensemble (recognizers=["rule", "ner"]), requires pip install openbtk[text] + python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm. Gated behind OPENBTK_SLOW_TESTS=1 (tests/accuracy/test_deid_f1_with_ner.py). Computed against the DEFAULT_SEED labelled_phi_corpus. NAME recall improves dramatically (0.0 -> 0.96) at a real precision cost (spaCy generic NER mistakes structured Label: VALUE text -- license numbers, URLs, even bare field labels -- for PERSON entities); GEOGRAPHIC_SUBDIVISION improves only marginally (0.0 -> 0.08) since Faker street addresses are not a shape en_core_web_sm recognizes well as GPE/LOC/FAC. DeidEngine shields rule detections from being overridden by overlapping NER ones (ADR-0006's own named mitigation), which is what keeps certificate_license_number and url at a perfect 1.0 despite NER's false positives elsewhere. This is an honest floor, not a target: a real biomedical/clinical-tuned NER model would very likely do better, especially on GEOGRAPHIC_SUBDIVISION. Updating this file requires a PR that states why (docs/07_TEST_CHARTER.md section 3.6).
